sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a car on a road; student picks a référentiel
(road / passing pedestrian / another car) via a picker. Trajectory of
a marked point (a fly on the roof) redraws differently depending on
chosen frame — horizontal line, stationary dot, inclined line. HUD:
scalar position s(t) along the road; introduces "trajectoire" and
"vitesse instantanée" qualitatively. Experiment: student reproduces
a target trajectory (e.g., "the fly's path relative to the pedestrian")
by picking the right référentiel. Evaluate: given a trajectory, student
names the frame that produced it. 2ème-level, scalars only, no vectors.
